insights.topic: Deterministic purchase signals vs. probabilistic targeting
insights.insight: 10,634 cryptographically verified receipts represent confirmed purchase events — not inferred intent. At a $5+ CPM industry benchmark for probabilistic signals, each verified receipt carries structural pricing power that cookie-based targeting cannot match.

Seven-day GMV of $242,124 on 1,906 receipts puts the $1M cumulative milestone roughly 2–3 days out from April 12; 14-day volume represents 41.5% of all-time GMV, confirming the acceleration is front-loaded and compounding, not averaging up.

insights.topic: Category diversity at 3.262 bits entropy — no single dominant vertical
insights.insight: Grocery, department stores, dining, gas, and now SaaS-subscription receipts coexist in the same verified stream, with the unclassified 'Unknown' bucket averaging $255 per receipt versus $94 for grocery — signaling high-value digital transactions are entering the network faster than classification can keep pace.

insights.topic: Digital commerce vendors confirmed in DKIM record
insights.insight: Amazon, Anthropic, OpenAI, Paddle, Gumroad, and Stripe are now represented as verified email-receipt sources, meaning subscription and creator-economy spend is sitting alongside physical retail in one unified purchase graph — a data layer that did not exist in this form before April 9.

insights.topic: Geographic footprint: 8 major metros plus non-metro rural entries
insights.insight: Confirmed CBSAs include NYC, LA, Philadelphia, Boston, Seattle, Miami, Tampa, and Pittsburgh, with non-metro entries across WA, OK, AL, ID, MI, TN, and others — the receipt graph is not confined to coastal urban clusters, which matters for CPG and auto-parts brands targeting mid-market geographies.

insights.topic: Peer-to-peer resale (Depop) now in the verified receipt stream
insights.insight: Depop's presence alongside Walmart and Costco confirms the network captures secondhand and recommerce transactions — a category most brand measurement tools treat as invisible, but one that directly indexes consumer sentiment on brand durability and resale value.
